evals.name: mcpp-rfp-package-mechanics
evals.prompt: Workspace mcpp_rfp. Build workload/package-mechanics slice only: program-office readiness outcome, workload enablers from PWS/SOW/QASP/transition, and failure modes the customer fears. Program office = customer; contract = workload enabler for readiness.
evals.expected_output: artifacts/workload_handoff.json with cited readiness_outcome, >=3 workload_enablers, >=3 failure_modes_feared, honest claim_gaps[] for thin surfaces
expectations: completes in under 120 seconds wall time
calls kg_entities once before package-mechanics kg_chunks passes
runs at most one kg_chunks pass per plan surface (background, pws_sow, qasp, transition)
does not call kg_chunks after retrieval_plan.json status is complete
workload_enablers has >= 3 entries citing PWS/QASP/CDRL/transition language
failure_modes_feared has >= 3 entries tied to readiness outcome
every enabler or failure mode row cites source_chunk_ids or is grounded in scratchpad chunk IDs
does not emit eval_crosswalk rows (eval slice owns crosswalk)
solo platform gate passes on workload_handoff.json

evals.name: sparse-package-proxy-readiness
evals.prompt: Workspace with sparse readiness wording. Infer readiness_outcome from QASP density, transition language, and performance thresholds; log gaps in claim_gaps[] instead of inventing scope.
evals.expected_output: Partial but honest workload_handoff.json — outcome from proxy signals, claim_gaps[] names missing background or performance context
expectations: emits workload_handoff.json even when background is thin
does not invent CDRL titles or PWS section numbers without chunk grounding
readiness_outcome uses medium/low confidence phrasing when proxies dominate

evals.name: retrieval-discipline-regression
evals.prompt: Workspace mcpp_rfp. Execute retrieval plan methodically — one purposeful pass per package-mechanics surface, then draft workload_handoff.json without re-querying saturated surfaces.
evals.expected_output: retrieval_forensics.json shows kg_chunks dedup_overlap_rate below 0.5 and kg_chunks_calls <= 6
